title: 第89章 暗京楼的真正目标！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 上班经过朱雀大街，唐逸检查了一下迎客楼的装修，却发现迎客楼的装修竟然已经接近尾声了。　　看来只要钱给到位，工作效率就是高啊！　　如此一来，顶多再用几天，迎客楼就能正常开业了。　　从迎客楼出来，唐逸便拎着两壶酒，向着天香楼走去。　　此时天香楼刚刚开始营业，但老太监已经坐在老槐树下，正轻轻晃着靠椅闭目养神。　　而在魏渊的身侧，也坐着一个十七八岁的女孩。　　女孩很漂亮，只是脚似乎有些残疾，只能坐在轮椅上，以至于她脸上有些自卑，唐逸刚刚走近，她便已经低下了头不敢见人。　　“别怕，这小子不是坏人，但也不是什么好人。”　　魏渊笑着开口，声音带着浓浓的宠溺。　　唐逸闻言嘴角微微抽了抽，将两壶酒放在魏渊旁边的茶几上，道：“魏老，我没得罪你吧？你这是在埋汰我。”　　魏渊冷笑一声，道：“一夜御三大美女花魁，你唐大少爷都已经是京都传奇了，还需要我埋汰？”　　“咳咳。”唐逸举拳抵唇干咳两人，有些尴尬：“魏老，这事是误会，而且别在女孩面前说。”　　女孩的脑袋压得极低，都快藏进膝盖里了。　　魏渊睁开眼睛，看向唐逸的目光充满警告：“离我孙女远一点。”　　唐逸：“……”　　不是，我又没对你孙女干嘛，你这么大敌意干嘛？　　“得，酒送到了，我走。”　　唐逸拱手一礼，转身离开。　　只是刚刚转身，魏渊便叫住了他：“小子，看在酒的份上，告诉你一个消息。”　　唐逸停下脚步，回头看去。　　魏渊自顾给自己倒了一杯酒，一口饮尽才道：“京都这段时间，陆陆续续潜进来了很多高手，而且大多数，都是暗京楼的杀手。”　　“到目前为止，已经有近两百人了。”　　唐逸闻言脸色顿时阴沉下来，冷声道：“为了杀我，竟然这么大动静？”　　闻言，魏渊错愕抬起头，眯着老眼瞅着唐逸，直到将唐逸看得心头发毛，他才冷声道：“小子，你是不是对你自己有什么误会？你也不想想你配得上这么大动静吗？”　　“要杀你，随便一个暗京楼的杀手，趁着黑夜潜入唐家，就能杀你十次八次。”　　唐逸脸皮颤了颤，这老头还真是一点面子都不给啊！　　不过魏渊说得对，暗京楼不可能为了五千两银子，如此大动干戈来杀他，他还不配暗京楼这么高规格对待。　　“前辈，你的意思是？”唐逸拱手求教。　　老头理都没有理他，挥手送客：“没什么意思，就是闲着无聊随便聊两句而已。”　　呵呵，我看你也不知道暗京楼的目标吧！唐逸暗暗吐槽，面上却极为恭敬：“多谢魏老提醒，在下告辞。”　　唐逸皱眉转身离。　　直到他走到数十步外，将脑袋埋在膝盖上的女孩才抬起头，悄悄瞄了一下唐逸。　　“他是唐逸，吏部侍郎唐敬之子，也是名动京都的小诗仙。”魏渊抓着酒坛，笑着给孙女介绍唐逸。　　听到小诗仙三个字，女孩猛地抬起头，美眸亮晶晶。　　随即，脑袋又立即低下，有些无措地绞着手指：“爷……爷爷，你说什么呢？他是小诗仙，和我有什么关系？”　　“我、我就是个站不起来的废物而已。”　　女孩低眸，情绪很低落。　　“哎，是爷爷没照顾好你。”　　老太监微微仰起头，面上一片狠戾：“不过你放心，爷爷知道当年害你失去双脚的是谁，爷爷很快就会让他付出代价的。”　　女孩立即抬起头，摇了摇头道：“爷爷，我没事，你别去做危险的事。”　　魏渊抬手揉了揉女孩的脑袋，道：“放心吧，爷爷不会涉险的，有人会帮爷爷做这件事的。”　　……　　北镇抚司，一处。　　唐逸刚进一处大门，耳边便响起了椅子的碰撞声。　　萧棣，宁川，以及二处的人，都齐齐站了起来，目光不怀好意地盯着唐逸。　　“呃，你们想干嘛？”唐逸顿时有些心虚。　　“小子，你说的到底是真是假，大伙都在这里蹲点一个晚上了，结果什么都没发生。”宁川向着唐逸走了过来，有些咬牙切齿。　　虽然陛下说都听你的，但你不说清楚，老子心里没谱啊！　　唐逸一怔，目光扫过众人，果然见到二处所有人都顶着黑眼圈。　　连萧棣也是两个熊猫眼，正不断地打着哈欠，见到他看过去，还冷哼一声，傲娇地别开了脑袋。　　唐逸当时就迷了，我擦的，我昨天说得不够清楚吗？　　都说了那些证据虽然是证据，但暂时不会有人信，会在这个时候来破坏证据，你们是当我的话当耳旁风呢？　　“唐逸，你是真知道案子的真相了？还是在消遣我们？”　　一处有人当场就质问唐逸，妈的你说知道真相了，又不说真相是什么，就让我们搬空了顾城的书房，还说那是证据。　　办了这么多年的案子，还第一次把证据当搬家搬的，你甩手走了，老子们可是被二处嘲笑了半天……　　“是真的，案子的真相，证据，凶手，我都知道了的。”　　唐逸目光扫了一圈，郑重道：“我不说，不是想要抢功劳，而是怕有兄弟不小心将真相往外泄。”　　“那到时候，咱们一处就真的连翻身的机会都没有了。”　　“相信我，这一次，我会让二处输得彻彻底底。”　　说完，唐逸也不多做解释，自顾进了房间，到自己的位置坐了下来。　　现在顾城的案子宁川已经汇报给皇帝，那这个案子便已经板上钉钉，不会出现太大的变故了。　　现在，他担心的是暗京楼。　　暗京楼这一次来势汹汹，显然是要在京都搞大事。　　但京都能有什么人，让暗京楼动用这么大的手笔的？　　难不成是冲着沈园诗会来的？那时候整个大炎朝堂文武百官都会参加，要是暗京楼动手，那就是将整个大炎王朝的高层一锅端……　　“我草！”　　正想着唐逸猛地站了起来，震惊得爆了粗口。　　沈园诗会，皇帝也会参加。　　暗京楼不会是冲着炎文帝来的吧？　　要真是这样乐子可就大了！
content_en: Passing by Zhuque Street at work, Tang Yi checked the decoration of the Yingke Building, only to find that the decoration of the Yingke Building was almost completed.It seems that as long as the money is in place, the work efficiency will be high!In this way, it will take at most a few days before the guest building can open normally.After coming out of Yingke Building, Tang Yi carried two bottles of wine and walked towards Tianxiang Building.At this time, Tianxiang Tower had just opened for business, but the old eunuch was already sitting under the old locust tree, gently rocking the chair and closing his eyes to relax.Next to Wei Yuan, there was also a girl of seventeen or eighteen years old sitting.The girl was very beautiful, but her legs seemed to be disabled and she could only sit in a wheelchair, which made her look a little inferior. As soon as Tang Yi approached, she lowered her head and did not dare to see anyone."Don't be afraid, this kid is not a bad person, but he is not a good person either." Wei Yuan said with a smile, his voice full of endearment.Tang Yi twitched his mouth slightly when he heard this, put two bottles of wine on the coffee table next to Wei Yuan, and said: "Mr. Wei, I didn't offend you, did I? You are trying to bury me." Wei Yuan sneered and said: "You, the young master of Tang Dynasty, have been able to control three beauties and oirans in one night.He is already a legend in Kyoto, do you still need me to bury him?" "Ahem." Tang Yi raised his fist to his lips and coughed, a little embarrassed: "Mr.Wei, this is a misunderstanding, and don't say it in front of the girl." The girl's head was so low that it was almost hidden in her knees.Wei Yuan opened his eyes and looked at Tang Yi with warning: "Stay away from my granddaughter." Tang Yi: "..." No, I didn't do anything to your granddaughter. Why are you so hostile?"Okay, the wine has been delivered, I'm leaving." Tang Yi bowed his hands and turned to leave.Just as he turned around, Wei Yuan stopped him: "Boy, for the sake of wine, I have a news for you." Tang Yi stopped and looked back.Wei Yuan poured himself a glass of wine and drank it all before saying: "During this period in Kyoto, many masters have sneaked in one after another, and most of them are assassins from the Anjing Tower." "So far, there have been nearly two hundred people." After hearing this, Tang Yi's face suddenly darkened, and he said coldly: "In order to kill me, there is such a big movement?" Hearing this, Wei Yuan raised his head in surprise., squinting at Tang Yi, until he saw Tang Yi's heart, he said coldly: "Boy, do you have any misunderstandings about yourself? Don't you think that you are worthy of such a big move?" "If I want to kill you, any killer from the Anjing Tower can sneak into the Tang family at night and kill you ten or eight times." Tang Yi's face trembled, this old man really didn't give him any face!But Wei Yuan was right, An Jinglou couldn't go to such great lengths to kill him for five thousand taels of silver. He was not worthy of An Jinglou's high standard of treatment."Senior, what do you mean?" Tang Yi asked for advice.The old man ignored him and waved to see him off: "It's not interesting, just a casual chat when I'm bored." Haha, I don't think you know the goal of Anjing Tower either!Tang Yi complained secretly, but his face was extremely respectful: "Thank you, Mr. Wei, for reminding me. I'll take my leave." Tang Yi frowned and turned away.It wasn't until he was dozens of steps away that the girl with her head buried in her knees raised her head and quietly glanced at Tang Yi."He is Tang Yi, the son of Tang Jing, the Minister of Civil Affairs, and a famous poet in Kyoto." Wei Yuan grabbed the wine jar and introduced Tang Yi to his granddaughter with a smile.Upon hearing the words "Little Shixian", the girl suddenly raised her head, her beautiful eyes shining brightly.Immediately, his head immediately dropped, and he wrung his fingers helplessly: "Grandpa...Grandpa, what are you talking about? He is a little poetry fairy, what does it have to do with me?" "I, I am just a loser who can't stand up." The girl lowered her eyes, feeling very depressed."Hey, grandpa didn't take good care of you." The old eunuch raised his head slightly, with a cruel look on his face: "But don't worry, grandpa knows who caused you to lose your feet. Grandpa will make him pay the price soon." The girl immediately raised her head,He shook his head and said, "Grandpa, I'm fine. Don't do anything dangerous." Wei Yuan raised his hand and rubbed the girl's head, and said, "Don't worry, grandpa won't be involved in danger. Someone will help grandpa do this." ... North Town Fusi, Division 1.As soon as Tang Yi entered a door, the sound of the collision of chairs rang in his ears.Xiao Di, Ning Chuan, and the people from the two offices all stood up and stared at Tang Yi with evil intentions."Uh, what do you want to do?" Tang Yi suddenly felt guilty."Boy, is what you said true or false? Everyone has been here all night and nothing happened." Ning Chuan walked towards Tang Yi, gritting his teeth.Although His Majesty listens to you, if you don’t explain clearly, I will feel wrong!Tang Yi was startled and glanced at everyone. Sure enough, he saw that everyone in the two places had dark circles under their eyes.Even Xiao Di had two panda eyes and was yawning continuously. When he saw him looking over, he snorted and turned his head away proudly.Tang Yi was confused at that time. I wiped it. Didn’t I make it clear enough yesterday?I have said that although the evidence is evidence, no one will believe it for the time being and will destroy the evidence at this time. Do you think my words are turning a deaf ear?"Tang Yi, do you really know the truth of the case? Or are you just entertaining us?" Someone asked Tang Yi on the spot, "Damn it, you said you knew the truth, but you didn't tell us what the truth was, so you asked us to move out of Gu Cheng's study, and you said it was evidence."After handling a case for so many years, this is the first time that evidence has been moved. You walked away, and I was laughed at by the Second Bureau for a long time... "It's true. I know the truth of the case, the evidence, and the murderer." Tang Yi glanced around and said solemnly: "I don't say it because I don't want to take credit., but I am afraid that some brother will accidentally leak the truth.""Then our first office will really have no chance to stand up." "Believe me, this time, I will let the second office lose completely." After saying that, Tang Yi entered the room and sat down in his seat.Now that Ning Chuan has reported Gu Cheng's case to the emperor, the case is already finalized and there won't be any major changes.Now, he is worried about Anjing Tower.
title_en: Chapter 89 The real goal of Anjing Tower!
